piece: 3 (student, layout loss, segment A + one DAgger round)

dagger.label_rule: every student decision that ran a forward pass (known set changed / first >= 6 known); cache-hit decisions carry the same known set and are not relabelled

open_loop.metric: per-item min over permutations (and over the K layouts given) of the mean site squared distance, box-normalised; K1_seed0 = the seed-0 layout only (the dev-visited states carry seed 0 only)
